description:
Flavorful chicken thighs for dinner.

Servings: 2

Ingredients:
4 chicken thighs
1 tbsp paprika
1 tsp salt
2 tbsp olive oil

Season the thighs. Sear in oil. Finish in the oven.
captions: Today we make flavorful chicken thighs. Season four thighs with paprika and salt. Sear them in two tablespoons of olive oil. Finish in the oven until cooked through.
